public.text: The business-services layer is described as shared reusable infrastructure extending the foundational layer. The criteria for determining why each listed service belongs in DPI-H rather than the functional-application layer remain insufficiently demonstrated.
public.suggestedRevision: Add a component-by-component classification matrix applying the Section 3.5.1 criteria and documenting why national shared provision is justified.
